questions.stem: When constructing an angle bisector, you draw arcs from the vertex and then from the two points where those arcs cross the angle's arms. The bisector passes through:

options.text: The point where the two new arcs intersect
The point equidistant from both endpoints of the line
A right angle to one of the arms

questions.explanation: The angle bisector is drawn from the vertex through the point where the two arcs (drawn from the points on each arm) intersect. This line divides the angle into two equal parts.
